items.name: Anders Larsson Memorial 2017
items.information: With this competition we remember our friend Anders Larsson, who did so many good things for WCA. During the competition we will have special moments to bring back good memories of Anders. We will also host the 'solving with feet' event, as this event was specifically requested by Anders to become an official event. Payment of registration fee of 50SEK will take place on-site on the day of the competition.

items.name: Deccan Cube Open - Sep 2017

venue.name: Rawindra Bhaarathi School
venue.address: 13, Dr A S Rao Nagar Rd, Arul Colony, Creative Nagar, Dr AS Rao Nagar, Secunderabad, Telangana 500062, India

items.information: Partipants needs to pre-register for the event in WCA as they will not be allowed to do any spot registrations on 17th September 2017 to participate. Participation registration for the event closes on 15th September 2017 at 9:00pm IST. Payment also should be made before 15th September 2017 9:00pm IST. Please note once you register in WCA site for the DC open - Sep 2017, your name will be in waiting list and once your payment is done then your name will appear in competitors list in 1-2 days. All the participants are requested to volunteer in the competition and every participant (except New comers) will be assigned to a particular event they have to Judge (or) Scramble for the entire event, all this will be decided by the organising team and will be informed 2 days before the event, we will make sure that your volunteering will not affect your main events. For payment of fees please go to the **Registration Fee and Payment Tab** Additional information will be provided in the tabs.

items.name: Yokohama 2017

venue.name: 横浜市西区西公会堂 (Yokohama Nishi Community Center)

items.information: 横浜大会2017は，横浜駅徒歩10分の会場にて，3x3x3キューブ3ラウンド，4x4x4キューブ2ラウンドのほか，片手，足，スクエア1競技を開催します。 Yokohama 2017 includes 3x3x3 (3 rounds), 4x4x4 (2 rounds), 3x3x3 One-handed, 3x3x3 with feet and Square-1 as its events. Feel free to ask us about our competition! kanto@jrca.cc Limited to 120 competitors
